audit.why: TF bullies 1-5 (Wild Cards range, gold card, blue-card mana), Veigar takes over from 6/first item — content prose already states this well.

audit.whatIsWrong: win[4] said Twisted Fate while whys[4], spikes[1] and late all say Level 6 turns for Veigar (Destiny adds no dueling power, Primordial Burst does).
audit.why: The token contradicted every prose field around it; kit supports the prose — Destiny is a reveal-and-teleport with no combat damage, Veigar 6 gains a 650-range execute.
audit.corrected: win[4] -> Veigar, paired with full phases[4].side Skill -> Veigar and a matching why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart rows 0-5 said Skill while content says TF x4 then Veigar x2 (after the win[4] fix); whys[3] credited 'Destiny-fueled roam pressure' to levels 4-5, before TF has R; cooldowns field had no digits; two copy-paste-bled bullets.
audit.why: Rows aligned with kit-grounded whys; whys[3] rewritten to the actual pre-6 pressure source (blue card mana, Q shove).
audit.corrected: See edits; cooldowns rewritten with 6s W cycle, 170s Destiny, 20s E.
6s Pick a Card, 170s Destiny, 20s E added.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his Destiny-fueled roam pressure outweighs your immobile clear.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his blue-card mana engine and Q shove out-tempo your immobile clear.

edits.before: Q through two units on every last-hit — each stack is permanent AP; the lane is a savings account from level 1.
edits.after: TF's three-card Wild Cards out-range you level 1 — stand behind casters, Q last-hits through two units, bank stacks.

edits.before: W on cage-stunned or rooted targets only — uncaged Dark Matter is a donation to his dodge stats.
edits.after: Gold card at 2 is his trade starter — back off when W glows; uncaged Dark Matter feeds his dodge stats.

edits.before: Cage online: drop it ON yourself when he engages, behind him when he farms — the geometry does the fighting.
edits.after: Cage online, still his lane — his 6s W cycle outpaces your 20s E; self-cage the gold-card step-up and farm.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-stack on cooldown and double-stack off cannon waves. The curve is the matchup.
edits.after: His blue-card mana engine shoves you in through 4-5 — Q-stack on cooldown and match waves so roams cost him.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: Destiny only roams, Primordial Burst duels — at 6 a caged gold-card attempt is a full-combo kill. Ward the Gate.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: Luden's completes the flip: cage-W-Q-R kills TF, who has no self-peel to answer. Your zone is law now.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Event Horizon (self-cage) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Pick a Card cycles every 6s — the locked gold card starts every trade and gank; back off the moment it glows yellow. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1: with it down his roam threat is walking speed. - Your 20s E has one job: the moment it goes wrong; R, the moment it goes right.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Primordial Burst scales off missing health — the instant TF turns to leave under half, the 650-range execute ends it.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: Wild Cards costs him 60 mana on a 6s cooldown — standing on one line eats three cards every wave; move on each cast.

edits.before: Twisted Fate wins by landing Pick a Card (Gold), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Twisted Fate wins by gold-carding your step-ups, shoving with Wild Cards, and Gate-ganking side lanes off Destiny.
